elements.name: rive.get_projection_matrix
elements.description: Returns the projection matrix in render coordinates.

elements.name: rive.set_file_listener
elements.description: Sets or clears the global file listener callback.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Callback invoked for file system events; pass nil to disable.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: One of onFileLoaded, onFileDeleted, onFileError, onArtboardInstantiated, onArtboardsListed, onViewModelsListed, onViewModelInstanceInstantiated, onViewModelInstanceNamesListed, onViewModelPropertiesListed, onViewModelEnumsListed

fields.name: data
fields.doc: Additional fields vary by event. Common keys include

fields.name: file
fields.doc: File handle involved in the event.

fields.name: viewModel
fields.doc: Instantiated view model instance handle, when applicable.

fields.name: viewModelName
fields.doc: View model name for the request, when applicable.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: Error message when a failure occurs.

elements.name: rive.get_file
elements.description: Returns the Rive file handle tied to the component.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: Component whose file handle to query.

elements.name: rive.set_artboard
elements.description: Switches the active artboard for the component.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: Component using the artboard.

parameters.name: name
parameters.doc: Name of the artboard to create and set. Pass nil to create a default artboard.

elements.name: rive.get_artboard
elements.description: Queries the current artboard handle for the component.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: Component whose artboard handle to return.

elements.name: rive.set_state_machine
elements.description: Selects a state machine by name on the component.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: Component owning the state machine.

parameters.name: name
parameters.doc: Name of the state machine to create and set. Pass nil to create a default state machine.

elements.name: rive.get_state_machine
elements.description: Returns the active state machine handle for the component.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: Component whose active state machine to query.

elements.name: rive.set_view_model_instance
elements.description: Selects a default view model instance by name.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: Component owning the view model instance.

parameters.name: name
parameters.doc: View model name whose default instance should be activated.

elements.name: rive.get_view_model_instance
elements.description: Returns the handle of the currently bound view model instance.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: Component whose view model instance handle to query.
